data_source: Stock-only daily Q-State causal snapshots plus immutable resolved Stock Truth outcomes
training_policy: Daily stock/equity states only. Train 10-bar swing and 20-bar position horizons with chronological train/calibration/test splits. Future bars are labels only and never enter state features.
learning_policy: New resolved examples expand the next candidate training set. A wrong decision is retained; production weights are never changed from one trade alone.
probability_policy: Laya confidence is displayed only after stock-domain held-out calibration and promotion. Until then the UI must show WITHHELD.
